findings.highlight: I told her we’ll try our best
findings.evidenceJa: これからよろしく、と
findings.governingReading: “I’ll be counting on you from now on,” I had said
findings.explanation: The reciprocal relationship opened by Shirou’s conventional future-facing greeting becomes a promise of generic shared effort.

findings.highlight: She shook the hand I held out
findings.evidenceJa: しっかりと握り返してくれた
findings.governingReading: she firmly clasped my offered hand in return
findings.explanation: Saber’s firm reciprocation and the tactile memory driving Shirou back are weakened to a routine handshake.

findings.evidenceJa: それでもこの手には、彼女の感触が残っていた
findings.governingReading: But still, I can feel
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly mangles Shirou’s pivotal recollection.

findings.highlight: there’s nothing else I can do
findings.evidenceJa: そんなの決まってるじゃないか
findings.governingReading: the answer is obvious
findings.explanation: Shirou’s declaration that his choice is already decided becomes a claim that no alternative exists.

findings.evidenceJa: 荒れ地
findings.governingReading: wasteland
findings.explanation: The established rough cemetery terrain is generalized into open ground.

findings.evidenceJa: 冗談のように重い墓石
findings.governingReading: gravestones of absurd, almost comical weight
findings.explanation: The narration’s astonished comparison and the extreme weight behind Berserker’s feat disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: ドンドンと音を立てて吹き飛ぶ墓石
findings.governingReading: gravestones go flying with repeated heavy thuds
findings.explanation: The sound and repeated violence of the cemetery’s destruction are removed.

findings.evidenceJa: とばっちり食らう
findings.governingReading: you’ll get caught in the collateral damage
findings.explanation: Rin’s warning about spillover from the superhuman battle becomes an unspecified direct hit.

findings.evidenceJa: もの凄い剣幕で怒っている
findings.governingReading: she is raging at me with tremendous force
findings.explanation: Rin’s visibly overwhelming tirade is reduced to a plain emotional label.

findings.evidenceJa: あいや、聞こえてた
findings.governingReading: Uh, I heard you
findings.explanation: A missing boundary produces malformed dialogue.

findings.evidenceJa: 腹は立たなかった
findings.governingReading: I was not angry
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lack of reciprocal anger becomes a vague absence of feeling bad.

findings.highlight: sure had a different face on at school
findings.evidenceJa: ホントに猫被ってたんだな、学校で
findings.governingReading: really was putting on an innocent facade at school
findings.explanation: The idiom that frames Rin’s school persona as deliberately meek or innocent becomes merely having a different face.

findings.evidenceJa: 本気でわたしたちを皆殺しにするつもりだろう
findings.governingReading: probably seriously means to kill every one of us
findings.explanation: Rin’s strongly grounded prediction is promoted into an unqualified statement of Illya’s intent.

findings.highlight: There should be something I can do as long as I’m alive
findings.evidenceJa: 体があるかぎり出来る事はある筈だ
findings.governingReading: As long as I still have a body, there must be something I can do
findings.explanation: Shirou’s characteristic idea that his body itself remains a usable means becomes the generic condition of being alive.

findings.highlight: are you going to ask someone to do something that you can’t do
findings.evidenceJa: 自分に出来ない事を人にやらせる気か
findings.governingReading: do you mean to make someone else do what you cannot do yourself
findings.explanation: The accusation of imposing an act on another person is softened into asking.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方に強制するなんて
findings.governingReading: forcing it on you
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit admission that she tried to compel Shirou is softened to a request.

findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーへ一刀を見舞う
findings.governingReading: delivers a sword stroke to Berserker
findings.explanation: Saber’s precise single counterstroke is generalized into an attack.

findings.highlight: a divine work of utmost excellence
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上はないという神業
findings.governingReading: a feat of skill beyond compare
findings.explanation: An idiom for consummate, superhuman technique becomes unnatural praise of a “divine work.”

findings.evidenceJa: 触れれば一瞬にして肉塊にされる旋風
findings.governingReading: a whirlwind that would reduce anyone it touched to a lump of flesh in an instant
findings.explanation: The concrete bodily stakes of entering Berserker’s reach disappear into abstract “fatal destruction.”

findings.evidenceJa: 鬼神でも戦い抜ける
findings.governingReading: fight all the way through even against a demon god
findings.explanation: Enduring the battle to its end becomes merely matching the opponent, while the supernatural enemy image is softened.

findings.highlight: she blocked Berserker’s sword on purpose
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーの剣を受けたのはワザと
findings.governingReading: she deliberately took Berserker’s sword blow
findings.explanation: Rin’s tactical reinterpretation of Saber accepting the blow becomes an intentional block, weakening the apparent sacrifice used to lure him.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦し紛れに薙ぎ払われる旋風
findings.governingReading: A desperate sweeping blow comes howling across
findings.explanation: The narration inserts “beast” as a direct label for Berserker where the source describes the attack as a whirlwind.

findings.highlight: holds her sword with both hands
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を両手で構え直す
findings.governingReading: resets her sword in a two-handed stance
findings.explanation: The deliberate reset of Saber’s stance before the finishing attack becomes a static hold.

findings.evidenceJa: 足が動く
findings.governingReading: My feet move
findings.explanation: Shirou’s body moving before conscious narration becomes a deliberate, generalized instant action.
